text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: gpu-pool-prod-1 under high pressure — queue depth > 12k, avg latency > 950ms, autoscaler failing to add nodes (scale_attempts=5, failures=5). Paging on-call: @jamie-eng and @leo-sre.

jamie-eng: seeing huge backlog on the inference queue. Throttles spiking around 18:02 UTC. Some requests are getting 429s.

maria-prod: customer-impact: two mid-market customers reporting timeouts, one internal canary failing healthchecks. Ticket numbers in support queue.

leo-sre: I'm looking at the autoscaler logs now. It requested additional nodes but cloud provider returned ENOSPC-like errors for placement. Suspect fragmentation in GPU binpacking + MIG sizing mismatch.

ashley-ml: confirm we recently rolled the new mig-profile: mig-1-8/2-16 yesterday in zone-b. Could be leftover slices preventing new instance placement.

carla-support: churn: multiple customers on Dedicated are seeing increased latency — sending proactive messages. Need ETA/impact to include in message.

jamie-eng: quick snapshot: replicas queued by model-type: small-gen=4.2k, medium-chat=6.1k, embeddings=2.0k. Token throughput stalled. Autoscaler logs: "scale rejected: insufficientPlacement" repeatedly.

leo-sre: running cloud provider placement query. Looks like there are many nodes with fragmented free GPUs: e.g., node-azb-47 has 1x8g free but lacks contiguous MIG shapes to satisfy new pod requests. Essentially we have stranded GPU capacity.

ops-bot: Deploy jobs blocked: job deploy/worker-upgrade-2026 pending due to insufficient GPUs.

jamie-eng: mitigation options we should consider now: 1) pause low-priority batch jobs 2) drop to smaller MIG profiles (if possible) 3) force-evict low-priority pods and binpack 4) temporarily bump max_nodes for pool to allow placement across zones. Thoughts?

leo-sre: I'm going to hand this to you @jamie-eng after I finish placement scan. I'll try a manual binpack: cordon a few fragmented nodes, migrate pods, then uncordon. Might free up contiguous GPUs.

maria-prod: please prioritize freeing capacity for Hosted API customers — particularly customers with SLA. Carla is collecting impacted customer list.

carla-support: affected customers: ACME-Insights (SLA), NovaRetail (high traffic). Both on hosted. Messaging drafted: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance due to GPU placement; working on mitigation."

jamie-eng: action plan v1: pause low-priority batches (ashley-ml confirm), trigger manual binpack on nodes with >1 fragmented slot, and temporarily increase autoscaler max_nodes by +20 while we rebalance. Also enable fallback routing to model-compact for non-critical requests.

ashley-ml: pausing experiments now — stopping 7 batch jobs (IDs: exp-4821..exp-4827).

leo-sre: starting binpack-scan. Running this script: 
```
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o name); do kubectl cordon $n && drain-evict-lowprio --node $n; sleep 2; kubectl uncordon $n; done
```
I'll watch scheduler events.

jamie-eng: I'm toggling routing rule: route non-critical traffic to model-compact-v2. This should shave token-load by ~30%.

ops-bot: autoscaler: attempt increase max_nodes -> 220 accepted by control-plane. Cloud account limit still 200 in zone-b. Need quota bump to actually provision.

leo-sre: quota problem — cloud quota hit in zone-b. I'll open a fast-ticket with provider and attempt multi-zone placement. In parallel will try to free existing capacity.

maria-prod: can we temporarily move some Dedicated for-commit workloads to other nodepool? That might be policy-blocked. Need approval from product.

jamie-eng: request for product approval: moving low-usage reserved pools for short window to free up for hosted customers. @maria-prod please confirm decision.

maria-prod: approved for 60m emergency rebalance. Notify customers affected by migration.

leo-sre: binpack run in progress. Initial wins: reclaimed 6 contiguous GPUs from 3 nodes by consolidating two small migs into bigger slices and evicting low-priority pods. Queue depth dropped to 7.3k. Latency improved to 720ms.

carla-support: update sent to customers AT 18:25 UTC. Responses: ACME-Insights acknowledged, NovaRetail asks for ETA.

jamie-eng: next mitigation: manually change MIG config on some nodes where possible. This is risky (reboot required). Recommend doing a staged mig resize in zone-c where we have lower traffic.

leo-sre: preparing sequence: 1) cordon node X 2) snapshot and drain 3) run provider API: set MIG profile to 2x16g 4) uncordon after reboot. Doing one a zone-c node now.

ops-bot: provider ticket opened: PLACEMENT-7890, requested urgent quota or cross-zone fallback. ETA from provider: 45-90m.

ashley-ml: after binpack + pause, embedding jobs still queued but they are lower TPS, ok to stay. Prioritizing small-gen and medium-chat.

jamie-eng: handoff: @leo-sre will continue remediation for next 30m, then @jamie-eng takes over for stakeholder comms and rollback decisions.

leo-sre: update after 18:40 UTC: we freed an extra 12 GPUs by migrating low-priority dedicated workloads to temporary pool. But found 2 nodes with partial MIGs that cannot be resized while live — they remain stranded (approx 10 GPUs).

maria-prod: impact status: degraded for 2 hosted customers, intermittent 429s for non-SLA customers. No data loss. Using this message to populate incident page.

carla-support: NovaRetail asked for a numeric ETA — please provide estimate when you have it.

jamie-eng: ETA: if provider escalates quota -> 30-60m to provision new nodes and let autoscaler balance. If quota remains stuck, we will need to do rolling MIG reconfigs across 6 nodes, estimate 90-120m. Communicating as 60-120m conservative.

leo-sre: current status at 18:50 UTC: queue depth 3.6k, latency 430ms, throttles dropped but not gone. Autoscaler still failing to place due to two fragmented racks in zone-b. Working with provider to allow cross-rack placement.

ops-bot: note: we've toggled fallback policies — customers on Dedicated retained performance via reserved pools; hosted customers saw decline until binpack completed.

maria-prod: please prepare postmortem checklist items: root cause hypothesis (MIG profile mismatch + binpack fragmentation + quota limits), detection timeline, customer impact, mitigations executed, follow-ups (auto defragmentation tooling, quota monitoring, safer MIG change rollout).

jamie-eng: follow-ups I'm adding: 1) implement a defragmentation controller that proactively consolidates pods 2) add placement-aware autoscaler retries that try alternate MIG shapes before failing 3) run a one-off audit of current MIG profiles across pools 4) update runbook for cross-zone quota failures.

leo-sre: handoff complete at 18:53 UTC — monitoring for 30m then close page if stable. Leaving cordon/drain run in progress.

carla-support: continuing to update customers. Will prep outbound note once we have provider ETA or full recovery.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated->monitoring. All actions recorded in incident page: /incidents/1858004321.

jamie-eng: thanks everyone — I'll own the post-incident writeup and follow-ups. If anything regresses ping me @jamie-eng.

leo-sre: logging final note: stranded capacity remains ~10 GPUs due to legacy MIG allocations; will schedule a maintenance window to consolidate next week.

carla-support: ticket close plan: wait 2 hours of stable latency before sending final customer update.

maria-prod: thumbs: :thumbsup: closing (for now).

ops-bot: autoclosed pager channel at 19:00 UTC (manual close).
